summary: v61i: tested GET /market/whoami, the WhoCanBuy panel on /market/{id}, admin bulk approve/reject of listings (API and UI), and reopening earlier catalogue imports (API and UI). One real Gemini import was run once for setup. Backend pytest: 11 of 12 passed. The 1 failure is a security issue: a buyer-organisation user can bulk-approve listings. UI: every requested flow worked. whoami returned the right kind for guest, supplier, staff and buyer. The blocked panel and its links (/buyers/apply, /login?next=/market/{id}) showed correctly. A buyer's Buy now still returned 200 and placed the order. Admin bulk select-all, select-none, per-row select, approve and reject (with confirm) all worked and showed the toasts, and the bulk bar was hidden once only 1 listing was pending. Reopening an import sent only GET imports, GET import/{id} and POST listings/bulk, with no new upload and no AI call. The draft kept its photos and the catalogue PDF spec sheet.

critical.issue: Buyer-organisation users can decide listings. The seeded buyer user (admin_users role 'admin', tenant source buyer_application) got 200 {decided:1}, and the listing went live. require_role(*STAFF) checks only the role. The platform admin also has role 'admin' (tenant PMC-KZ-01), so nothing separates PMC staff from buyer-org admins. Fix: deny staff marketplace endpoints when the user's tenant has source == 'buyer_application', or gate them on a platform-tenant or is_platform flag. Note: this depends on real buyer-org users being created with role 'admin', which is how the test seed creates them.

minor.issue: skipped = len(body.ids) - decided, so duplicate ids are counted as skipped. Only cosmetic.

ui_bugs.issue: After a bulk action, the bulk 'Waive sale fee' box and 'Note to suppliers' text are not reset, so they carry into the next batch. Verified: after approving with note 'TEST bulk ok' and waive on, the next bulk reject saved review_notes='TEST bulk ok' and sale_fee_waived=true, and the supplier sees that approval note on a rejected listing. Fix: reset waive.__bulk and notes.__bulk after a successful bulk call.

issues: The Buy now, bid and offer buttons stay enabled under the blocked panel, so a guest, staff user or supplier who clicks still gets the raw 403. Consider disabling them or hiding them when blocked.
A supplier viewing their OWN verified_buyers listing reads 'this seller only sells to buyer organisations'. It should say this is your listing.
On an any_verified listing, a guest only gets 'Sign in as a buyer' and 'Apply as buyer'. There is no 'sign in or register as a supplier' path, although suppliers can take part.
The public header still shows 'Sign in' / 'Register as supplier' when the user is signed in (existing behaviour).
The thumbnail of the existing 'Great Container' listing is a broken image (this is user data, not test data).

action_items: HIGH: block buyer-organisation tenant users (tenant.source == 'buyer_application') from the staff marketplace admin endpoints, including bulk-decision, single decision, settings and orders/payout. Better: use a proper platform-staff check.
Reset the bulk waive and note state in AdminMarketE after a bulk approve or reject succeeds.
Optional: disable the buy/bid/offer controls when WhoCanBuy is blocked; add an own-listing message; add a supplier sign-in link on any_verified listings.
critical_code_review_comments: market_whoami: the vendor cookie is checked first, so a browser that has both a vendor and an admin session is reported as supplier. This matches _bidder, so it is consistent.
list_imports: owner-scoped, done-only, limit 20, and the products.title projection is efficient. Verified that another vendor gets an empty list and 404 on GET import/{id}.
Reopening an import does not record that drafts were already created from it, so a supplier can create duplicate drafts of the same product. Consider marking products already drafted.

success_rate.backend: 92% (11/12; the 1 failure is the buyer-org authorization issue)
